output: # ÜSCRIPTS ÜFOR ÜADMINISTRATORS ÜA ÜBASH ÜSCRIPT ÜTHAT ÜCHECKS ÜEVERY ÜDEVICE: ```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail # Stop on the first device that fails for host in $(cat hosts.txt); do ssh "$host" ctsync status --json > "status-$host.json" # one file per device done # Print a summary jq -s 'map(.state) | group_by(.) | map({state: .[0], count: length})' status-*.json ``` ÜTHE ÜSAME ÜCHECK ÜIN PowerShell: ```powershell <# .SYNOPSIS Collects the sync status from all devices. .DESCRIPTION Reads the device names from hosts.txt and writes one JSON file per device. #> param([string]$HostFile = 'hosts.txt') # Collect the results in a list $results = foreach ($h in Get-Content $HostFile) { Invoke-Command -ComputerName $h { ctsync status --json } # runs remotely } $results | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content summary.json ``` ÜA Windows ÜBATCH ÜFILE: ```bat @echo off REM Restart the sync service net stop ContosoSync net start ContosoSync :: Done ```
